# Closing the workshop for the holidays

Announced the final opening day before asking who could cover January. Several people visibly relaxed. A service run by volunteers needs a predictable interval when it is unavailable. The waiting time for a repair will be longer; the alternative was asking the same tired people to rescue an unstaffed rota. [[Volunteer handbook]] should make planned closure easy to communicate.
